Calder Bridge: opened 1931, main span 412 m, designer Ines Varga. Source: county archive.

steps.text: The Calder Bridge opened in 1931 and its main span is 412 m. It was designed by Ines Varga.
My guidebook says it opened in 1934. Which is right?
Calder Bridge opening ceremony held 4 May 1934; construction finished 1931. Source: newspaper archive.

steps.text: I need to correct myself. Construction finished in 1931, but the bridge was opened on 4 May 1934. The main span is still 412 m.
Thanks. Who built it and how many lanes does it carry?
Contractor: Harrow Steelworks. Lanes: 4 after the 1978 widening, originally 2. Main span 410 m after remeasurement.

steps.text: It was built by Harrow Steelworks. It carries 4 lanes since the 1978 widening, and a remeasurement puts the main span at 410 m, not 412 m.
Please note the designer is listed as Ines Varga-Cole in the later records. Can you give me a one-line summary?
The Calder Bridge, designed by Ines Varga-Cole and built by Harrow Steelworks, opened on 4 May 1934 with a 410 m main span and 4 lanes.
